description: Ontology & cross-dimensional linking — defines the relationship-type vocabulary and infers edges across the temporal, geographic, linguistic, and genetic/derivation dimensions, including a dedicated discovery effort for the under-sourced linguistic and genetic dimensions, turning a flat set of category nodes into a dense connected network.

userStories.title: Define the relationship-type ontology as data
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the edge vocabulary defined formally so linkers and exporters share one source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Encode the ontology from docs/data-model.md (LOCATED_IN, CONTEMPORARY_WITH, DESCENDS_FROM, DERIVED_FROM, etc.) as a typed registry with each type's domain, range, dimension, and symmetry/transitivity flags
Provide a lookup API and a validator that rejects edges whose :TYPE is not registered
Tests pass (pytest) for lookup, unknown-type rejection, and symmetry/transitivity flags
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Define the Linker interface and pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I want pluggable linkers so each dimension's inference is isolated and composable.
acceptanceCriteria: Define abstract Linker with link(nodes, edges) -> new_edges and a registry by dimension
A pipeline runs registered linkers in order and appends inferred edges, never mutating source rows
Inferred edges are tagged with source='inferred:<linker>' and a confidence
Tests pass (pytest) running two stub linkers through the pipeline
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Implement the geographic linker (LOCATED_IN / ORIGINATES_FROM)
userStories.description: As a user, I want entities connected to places so the network is geographically navigable.
acceptanceCriteria: Create or reuse place nodes from place_qid / tgn_id / pleiades_id and link entities via LOCATED_IN and ORIGINATES_FROM
Where only lat/lon exist, attach to the nearest known place within a configurable radius and flag lower confidence
Emit ADJACENT_TO edges between places sharing a containment/border relation when available from source data
Tests pass (pytest) on a fixture of entities with QIDs, coords-only, and TGN ids
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Implement the temporal linker (CONTEMPORARY_WITH / PRECEDES / PART_OF_PERIOD)
userStories.description: As a user, I want entities connected in time so I can explore what coexisted or preceded what.
acceptanceCriteria: Emit CONTEMPORARY_WITH between entities with overlapping [time_start,time_end] spans (configurable overlap threshold)
Emit PRECEDES/FOLLOWS for non-overlapping ordered events
Emit PART_OF_PERIOD linking entities to named period nodes, creating period nodes idempotently
Guard against combinatorial explosion: contemporaneity is only computed within a shared facet (category/region) unless explicitly widened
Tests pass (pytest) for overlap, ordering, and the explosion guard
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Discover and document open linguistic data sources
userStories.description: As a researcher, I need vetted linguistic sources because the prior-art research found none confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluate and document candidate sources (Glottolog, WALS, PHOIBLE, Wiktionary etymology, Wikidata language-family properties) for coverage, format, and license in docs/sources-linguistic.md
Pick at least one ingestible source and add a category spec / dump adapter config for it
Record which Wikidata properties express DESCENDS_FROM / BORROWED_FROM / COGNATE_WITH
Tests pass (pytest) validating the new linguistic category spec loads
Lint passes (ruff)

userStories.title: Implement the linguistic linker (DESCENDS_FROM / BORROWED_FROM / COGNATE_WITH / SPOKEN_IN)
userStories.description: As a user, I want language and term relationships so etymological and language-family connections are queryable.
acceptanceCriteria: Build language-family DESCENDS_FROM edges from the source chosen in US-005
Emit SPOKEN_IN edges linking languages to places
Emit BORROWED_FROM / COGNATE_WITH edges for terms when etymology data is present
Tests pass (pytest) on a fixture language-family tree producing a connected DESCENDS_FROM chain
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Discover and document genetic/derivation data sources
userStories.description: As a researcher, I need vetted cultural-lineage sources because the prior-art research found none confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: Document in docs/sources-genetic.md the meaning of the 'genetic' dimension here (cultural lineage/derivation, not biology) and candidate sources (Wikidata 'derived from'/'influenced by'/'based on' properties; domain lineage datasets)
Enumerate the Wikidata property ids used for DERIVED_FROM / INFLUENCED_BY / VARIANT_OF
Add a category-spec snippet showing how to pull derivation edges from Wikidata
Tests pass (pytest) validating that snippet loads
Lint passes (ruff)

userStories.title: Implement the genetic/derivation linker (DERIVED_FROM / INFLUENCED_BY / VARIANT_OF)
userStories.description: As a user, I want cultural-lineage edges so I can trace how dishes, styles, and artifacts descend from one another.
acceptanceCriteria: Map the Wikidata properties from US-007 to DERIVED_FROM / INFLUENCED_BY / VARIANT_OF edges between existing nodes
Skip edges whose endpoints are not in the node set and log the count skipped
Populate the denormalized derived_from_csid convenience column on nodes where a single primary ancestor exists
Tests pass (pytest) on a fixture with derivation statements producing the expected edges
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Implement cross-category entity stitching
userStories.description: As a user, I want the same entity appearing in multiple categories to be one node so categories interconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: When two category outputs contain nodes with the same csid, merge them (reusing the resolution logic) so categories share entities
Shared entities retain MEMBER_OF_CATEGORY edges to every category they belong to
A report lists cross-category shared entities and their categories
Tests pass (pytest) stitching two fixture categories that share an entity
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Add graph connectivity metrics
userStories.description: As a user, I want to measure how dense/connected the network is so I can tell whether linking is working.
acceptanceCriteria: Compute node count, edge count, edges-per-node, connected-component count, and largest-component fraction over a TSV dataset
Break down edge counts by dimension and :TYPE
Output a metrics JSON and a short printed summary
Tests pass (pytest) asserting metrics on a known fixture graph
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Add a link CLI command
userStories.description: As a user, I want one command that enriches canonical TSV with all inferred cross-dimensional edges.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `culturescrape link <dir> --dimensions temporal,geographic,linguistic,genetic --out <dir>`
Command runs the linker pipeline and writes augmented edge files plus a connectivity-metrics report
Running on a fixture dataset increases edge count and passes schema validation
Tests pass (pytest) invoking the CLI on a fixture
Type checks pass (mypy)

userStories.title: Document the ontology and linking model
userStories.description: As a user, I want the relationship vocabulary and inference rules documented so the network is interpretable.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/ontology.md lists every :TYPE with domain/range/dimension/symmetry/transitivity and the inference rule that produces it
Include a diagram (text/mermaid) of how dimensions interconnect entities
Each documented inference rule references the test that exercises it
Tests pass (pytest) for the referenced rule tests
Lint passes (ruff)
